weaknesses: The abstract could better clarify the specific contributions of the IRS method compared to existing approaches.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the IRS method, particularly in scenarios with high variability in model modifications.
The experimental results lack a comprehensive comparison with other state-of-the-art certification methods beyond the baseline.
strengths: The introduction of the Incremental Randomized Smoothing (IRS) method is a novel contribution to the field of robustness certification for neural networks.
The paper provides a clear theoretical foundation for the IRS approach, supported by rigorous mathematical proofs.
Empirical results demonstrate significant speedups in certification time, indicating practical applicability and impact.
